reason: Node-read slowness in Metaform took a session of guessing; the fix came from timing the read inside a fresh request scope and from finding a search that re-split a whole cited file per candidate position. A class-level skill for profiling Metaform reads lets the next slow read start from measurement.
The agents-read profiling showed four reusable pitfalls the skill lacks: copies that hide runner cost, statement-count guards, concurrent runner asks, and interleaved rounds under load.
